review.name: Tempest Pegasus
findings: All twelve fresh source face/body raw slices actually inspected across all thirteen clips. Equine face, mane and neck retain their shapes; wings meet torso continuously and four legs stay connected during gait, jump, strike, recoil and defeat. Source raw first pass only; battle and actual equipped techniques not yet visually reviewed.

First pass completed with all 24 raw source/battle face/body slices and all 216 native equipped-technique frames actually inspected. Equine muzzle, eyes, mane, neck, folded wings, torso and four legs remain coherent. Forward foreleg reach blends into the whole-body attack hop and recovery without detached feet or torn shoulders. Frozen face and full geometry checks pass both versions. No model repair required; final repeat and runtime review pending.

Second pass actually inspected and passed all 24 source/battle raw face/body slices, all 32 runtime transition slices at low/medium, 216 native equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless strips, 24 advancing companion idle frames and sixteen atlas cells. Source and battle model bytes unchanged. Whole-roster/main/live verification remains pending.
